install_steps: brew install mutagen-io/mutagen/mutagen || curl -sSfL https://github.com/mutagen-io/mutagen/releases/latest/download/mutagen_linux_amd64.tar.gz -o /tmp/mutagen.tar.gz && tar xzf /tmp/mutagen.tar.gz -C ~/.local/bin
note: Single static binary; starts its own daemon on first 'mutagen daemon start' (or automatically). Linux/macOS/Windows binaries and 'go install' available. Remote endpoints need only SSH + a POSIX shell — the mutagen agent is copied automatically.
